input: Research cord blood banking before the birth

gold.taskTitle: Research Cord Blood Banking Before the Birth
gold.taskDescription: Research cord blood banking options and make an informed decision before the baby is born.

questions.title: What is your approximate due date or time left?
questions.description: Understanding the timeline helps prioritize how urgently this research needs to happen.

questions.title: Are you leaning toward private banking or public donation?
questions.description: Knowing if there is already a preference helps focus the research on the relevant option.

questions.title: What is the primary reason you want to bank cord blood?
questions.description: Understanding the motivation (e.g., family medical history, general precaution) shapes which information matters most.

questions.title: Do you have a specific budget in mind for private banking?
questions.description: Private cord blood banking has significant upfront and annual storage costs that vary by provider.

questions.title: Has your doctor or midwife already recommended any specific banks?
questions.description: A healthcare provider recommendation can narrow down the list of options to evaluate.

questions.title: Which country or region will the birth take place in?
questions.description: Available banks, regulations, and public donation programs differ significantly by location.

questions.title: What does your research output look like -- a decision, a shortlist, or notes?
questions.description: Clarifying the desired end result helps structure the research into the right deliverable.
